chapter: Pay, the Fletcher Henderson circle and later life
title: Fletcher Henderson at the Club Bandville and Broadway Jones
summary: Fletcher led the band at the Bandville on 129th Street under Broadway Jones's name; Jones was an entertainer who sang big show songs at society gigs.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: His quality -- When I got to New York with Mamie, the following year after that, he worked, and he was working down at the Bam Bandville Club. Then he went with Fletcher, and then he --
Who was he in the Bam Bandville with?
(that's where Fletcher started
Fletcher had that -> Barn Fletcher started this band at the Club Bandville, 129th Street. It's just off of Lenox Avenue.
Yeah. Do you know -- that's a funny thing, though. Somebody told me -- you know Lois Deppe Norris Step, of course, the --
Yeah, the vocalist.

Yeah. Well, he -- you know, he's got a good memory kind of (unintelligible), and he told me that the first time he went to New York, and I think it was the Barn Bandville, Fletcher was playing piano, and it was not his band.
Right. It wasn't.
Was that under the name of Broadway Jones?
Broadway Jones had at the club. That's right.
So Fletcher --
That's right.
-- was really the leader.
That's right.
But it was -- well, what was Broadway Jones?
He was an entertainer.
Oh, a performer -- so they called it his band.
A singer --
: -- with the band.

That's right. He's right about that. He's right about that. He sang, big fellow, heavy set, big, dark fellow. He'd sing all them big songs like 'Mother Macree.' He'd break up the house. (Unintelligible) because we used to go on gigs with him, you know, because we used to call -- it's called entertaining all them millionaires and things or out there in Oyster Bay where people have (unintelligible) them big yachts and all. He'd get up and sing. He played banjo. He didn't have to worry about playing banjo because he could sing so much. He'd get to do all them big show songs from the shows down on Broadway and all.
